name: caption_reliability_filter_v1
label: Partner-independent caption-reliability weights in a language PCA basis
caption_rule: smallest five COCO annotation ids; position 0 is the archived caption
pooling: attention-mask mean of the last decoder-block residual, left pad, no chat template, no truncation
clip_rule: exact order statistic index int(0.95 * numel), inherited from metrics.remove_outliers / clip_threshold
row_normalization: L2 on rows immediately after clipping and before centring, PCA and filtering; no post-filter row normalization
pca_rule: economy SVD of training-caption centred features; keep every mode with singular value > pca_rank_tol * leading singular value, capped at n-1
